scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.test: docker start rush-pos_postgres || true && bun --env-file=.env.test run --filter @rush-pos/server db:migrate && bun --env-file=.env.test run --filter './packages/*' test
scripts.test:coverage: docker start rush-pos_postgres || true && bun --env-file=.env.test run --filter @rush-pos/server db:migrate && bun --env-file=.env.test run --filter './packages/*' test --coverage
scripts.db:start: docker start rush-pos_postgres || docker run -d --name rush-pos_postgres -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=rush-pos -v rush-pos_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data -p 5432:5432 postgres:16
scripts.dev:full: bun run db:start && bun run db:migrate && bun --env-file=.env.development run --filter './packages/*' dev
